classical_and_foundational_inputs.name: Same original pinned moduli datum and valid uniformization
classical_and_foundational_inputs.statement: The fixed D,T,Q,c,l, row, good embedding, original moduli uniformization, its algebraic rule evaluation and naturality. The common-family existence is not asserted. The qualitative CM argument is applied to this supplied actual moduli object.

classical_and_foundational_inputs.name: Riemann uniformization and algebraicity of CM abelian varieties
classical_and_foundational_inputs.statement: A polarized complex torus is algebraic, and a complex abelian variety with a commutative semisimple endomorphism algebra of dimension twice its dimension has a number-field model with its finite polarization/action/level data after finite extension. The chosen frame fibre is the actual finite-type algebraic fibre.
classical_and_foundational_inputs.application_checked: ICL3 makes an orthogonal decomposition into E-lines; the lattice is commensurable with their sum, giving E^r in End^0 and precisely the CM dimension. ICL4 descends finite data and uses the same moduli fibre.

classical_and_foundational_inputs.name: Serre-Tate potential good reduction for CM abelian varieties
classical_and_foundational_inputs.statement: At each finite place with finite residue field, a CM abelian variety acquires good reduction after finite extension.
classical_and_foundational_inputs.application_checked: ICL5 applies it only at the finitely many bad finite places, then proves the global finite-extension/gluing step using weak approximation, Krasner and normal closure.

classical_and_foundational_inputs.name: Abelian scheme extension, cube and coherent base change
classical_and_foundational_inputs.statement: Homomorphisms of abelian schemes extend uniquely over a normal Dedekind base; rigidified generic line bundles extend as the appropriate cubical line bundles; a principal ample line bundle has a rank-one relative section module commuting with base change. Flat base change and torsion-freeness are used for the integral Lie kernels; no ramified integral eigenspace direct-sum theorem is assumed.
classical_and_foundational_inputs.application_checked: ICL5 keeps the original polarization and its inverse and rigidification, extends action maps, identifies whole saturated integral Lie eigenspace kernels, and ICL6 principalizes their projective modules after a finite field extension.

classical_and_foundational_inputs.name: Harish-Chandra fixed-type automorphic finite-dimensionality
classical_and_foundational_inputs.statement: The holomorphic cusp forms of one fixed highest weight on each fixed arithmetic uniformization component form a finite-dimensional complex space.
classical_and_foundational_inputs.application_checked: ICL8 uses only the given finite component family and fixed weight. It proves preservation of finite K-linear independence after the fixed complex scalar extension from reduced finite-type test rings, so it obtains the literal K-space dimension assertion.
